# 🚀 What type of change is this? 🛠️

> 📝 **This is the default PR template.** Please select the option below 🔗 that best matches your change to load the appropriate checklist. 🎯

* [🐛 **Load Bug Fix Template**](?template=bug_fix.md) — 🔧 Fixes an existing bug or unexpected behavior. Includes 🧪 regression testing, 🔍 root-cause analysis, 🛡️ security checks, and 🚀 deployment verification.
* [✨ **Load New Feature Template**](?template=feature.md) — 🚀 Introduces new functionality or capabilities. Includes 🧪 UT/IT coverage, 📊 code coverage, 🧬 mutation testing, 🔐 security, 📚 documentation, and 🚀 deployment readiness.
* [💥 **Load Breaking Change Template**](?template=breaking_change.md) — ⚠️ Introduces changes that may affect existing APIs, contracts, database schemas, integrations, or consumers. Includes 📋 impact analysis and 🔄 migration/rollback planning.
* [♻️ **Load Refactor / Chore Template**](?template=chore.md) — 🧹 Refactoring, dependency updates, technical-debt cleanup, CI/CD changes, maintenance, or code-quality improvements. Includes 🧪 regression verification and 📈 quality checks.
* [📚 **Load Documentation Update Template**](?template=docs.md) — 📝 Updates README files, API documentation, Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, diagrams, guides, or other project documentation. Includes ✍️ content checks, 🔗 link verification, 🧪 technical accuracy, and 🖼️ preview validation.
* [🚑 **Load Production Hotfix Template**](?template=hotfix.md) — 🔥 Emergency production fix intended to restore service or mitigate a critical incident quickly. Includes 🚨 incident details, ⚠️ risk assessment, 🔙 rollback planning, 🧪 emergency testing, 📡 monitoring, and 🏁 post-incident follow-up.

---

## 🧭 Choosing the Right Template

| 🏷️ Change Type          | 🎯 Use When                                                  | 🔑 Primary Focus                           |
| ------------------------| ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ |
| 🐛 **Bug Fix**          | Existing functionality is broken or behaving incorrectly     | 🔍 Root Cause + 🧪 Regression Tests        |
| ✨ **New Feature**      | Adding new functionality or capability                       | 🚀 Functionality + 🧪 Testing + 📊 Metrics |
| 💥 **Breaking Change**  | Existing consumers, APIs, schemas, or contracts are affected | ⚠️ Impact + 🔄 Migration                   |
| ♻️ **Refactor / Chore** | Improving code without changing business behavior            | 🧹 Quality + 🛠️ Maintainability            |
| 📚 **Documentation**    | Updating project or technical documentation                  | 📝 Accuracy + 🔗 Usability                 |
| 🚑 **Production Hotfix**| Urgent production issue requiring immediate remediation      | 🚨 Recovery + 🔙 Rollback                  |

---

💡 **Don't need a specific template?**

🗑️ If none of the above applies, simply remove this section ✂️ and describe your changes below. 📝

🎯 **Choose the template that best matches your PR:**
🐛 Bug Fix → ✨ New Feature → 💥 Breaking Change → ♻️ Refactor/Chore → 📚 Documentation → 🚑 Production Hotfix
